name: Tofu Mason Jar "Grain Bowl" with Farro, Zucchini, Bell Pepper, Spinach & Lemon-Hummus Dressing (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lemon
2 medium zucchini squash
1 red bell pepper
½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Zest lemon into a medium bowl (reserve lemon for later use).
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon zest, along with oil and spices. Stir to combine the spice paste.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 clove garlic
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Add to the bowl with the spice paste.
Trim and medium dice zucchini. Add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.

Medium dice tofu, add to the bowl, and stir to combine. Wipe the baking sheet dry with paper towels, then return tofu and veggies to the baking sheet, spreading them out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, stirring halfway through, until tofu is golden and veggies are tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool, about 20 minutes.

Meanwhile, place water in a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Once boiling, add farro and salt, then stir for a few seconds. Reduce heat to low and simmer until farro is tender, 10-15 minutes. When the farro is done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool; set aside to drain further.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup farro, quick-cooking
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the farro is cooking, juice lemon into the reserved bowl, then add hummus and water. Whisk to combine the dressing and divide between two (quart-sized) jars.
When the tofu, veggies, and farro are cool, add to the jars with the dressing. Top with spinach, packing lightly if necessary.
Screw lids onto jars and store in the fridge until needed. (Best if used within 2-3 days.)
When ready to eat, empty jar into a bowl (making sure to scrape out all of the dressing!), then stir to combine. Enjoy!
